bagPolicy.summary: The BJCC Arena requires bags to be clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC and not exceed 12″x6″x12″. Non-clear bags must be smaller than 5″x7″ to be permitted.
allowed: CLEAR plastic, vinyl or PVC bags not exceeding 12″x6″x12″
prohibited: Bandanas (if being used to obscure face)
Coolers, ice chests, or thermos containers
Firearms (including law enforcement personnel not present in an official capacity)
Items too large to fit under a seat
Professional recording devices for photography, video or audio
Umbrellas (unless they fit inside the clear bag)
Water bottles (except clear, reusable water bottles in Protective Stadium)
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions to the Bag Policy may be made for medically necessary items after inspection. Diaper bags must be clear and meet specifications.

parking.note: The BJCC offers over 14,500 cashless parking spaces within a 5-10 minute walk from the venue. Availability varies by event, so check your Know Before You Go email for details. ADA and Tesla charging options are available in some lots.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in BJCC Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The BJCC Arena is a cashless venue, accepting only credit/debit cards and digital payments for all concessions. Outside food and beverages are not allowed, ensuring guests purchase from the available options inside.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: ADA and wheelchair-accessible seating is available throughout our venues and can be purchased on Ticketmaster.com. Accessible entrances are located at the main Concert Hall entrance, off the BJCC Green, and at the 11th Avenue Parking entrance.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in BJCC Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: BJCC Concert Hall Ticket Office: Opens two (2) hours before the scheduled show time Protective Stadium Ticket Office: Opens two (2) hours before scheduled kickoff, except for UAB Blazers which opens four (4) hours before scheduled kickoff.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gate times at Protective Stadium vary by event – UAB and UFL football gates open 90 minutes prior to kickoff and Legion FC gates open 60 minutes prior to kickoff. East Exhibit Halls: Accessible entrances for the Exhibit Halls and Ballrooms are located on the ground level of the East Exhibit Hall.
